title: Basic Road Safety and Traffic Compliance

location.scope: Bali-wide; verify local and site-specific rules

content.definition: Road users must obey signs and directions, use required safety equipment, respect passenger limits, and avoid impaired or distracted driving.
content.cultural_context: The 2025 circular requires valid licences, compliance with traffic rules, helmets, obedience to signs, passenger limits, and no driving under the influence of alcohol or illegal drugs. Bali Police have highlighted helmet and seatbelt use, phone use while driving, wrong-way driving, underage riding, and overloading as enforcement concerns.
content.significance: Road safety protects drivers, passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other road users.
common_situations: Riding a scooter with a passenger

do: Wear a properly fastened motorcycle helmet
Follow signs, signals, and police directions
Stop safely before using a phone
dont: Use a mobile phone while driving
Drive if underage or not legally licensed

common_misconceptions: A short ride or quiet road does not make safety requirements optional.
A rental provider handing over a vehicle does not transfer responsibility for safe driving.
regional_variations: Traffic density and road conditions vary; follow current signs and police directions.
content.additional_notes: Police reporting identifies enforcement priorities, not a complete list of offences or penalties.

sources.title: Bali Governor Circular Letter No. 07 of 2025 on Foreign Tourist Conduct
Bali Police Urge Vehicle Rental Companies to Educate Foreign Tourists on Traffic Rules

verification.verification_notes: The core obligations are explicit in the Governor Circular and reinforced by Bali Police communications.

sensitivity.handling_notes: Use neutral, precise wording; distinguish formal rules from courtesy recommendations.
